value.rationale: Rational bitangents are a canonical arithmetic geometric invariant of smooth nonhyperelliptic genus-three curves, equivalent to Frobenius-fixed odd theta characteristics in odd characteristic. The complete F7 pointless class spectrum and sharp unique extremizer are natural arithmetic classifications, and the pair with same Weil and automorphism group but different rational bitangent counts demonstrates that this invariant refines common arithmetic/geometric classifiers, not arbitrary coefficient slicing.
